_comment: The maps verified against the checklist (VERIFICATION.md): map name as the game names it -> the checklist version it passed, the heroes-capture version, and a note. `checklist` is the checklist's current version: bumped whenever the render changes (prepare, capture, stitch, pack, the script parts, the pack format), which drops every map to unverified until it passes again. A map at an older number is known (its handling is in place: arenas and brawls render) but not verified.

Battlefield of Eternity.note: the standard: elements render, team colour on structures and doodads, sky layers, loading screen and icons, custom minimap, the arches past the top edge, the east chains' edge black

Dragon Shire.note: black-terrain void made transparent; elements render: towns, outposts and camps from its differently named hookup functions; copies in its void corners came out black (the calibration checks spots now); forts shot from the wrong side (the shots wait for the switch to be drawn now)

Punisher Arena.note: three arenas, one image each without the others' edges; sky layers; quit ends the match; elements placed on each arena's own image; the viewer switches arenas; the north orb's edge black removed

Volskaya Foundry.note: black-terrain void made transparent; the game's camera bounds tighter than the map file's (grid re-planned); custom minimap placement corrected (minimap-placement.json); last rendered at pack format 4
